jobs.title: Account Executive, Mid Market
jobs.description: We’re hiring a driven and consultative Mid-Market Account Executive to help accelerate Lattice’s next phase of growth. This is an opportunity for ambitious sales professionals who thrive in fast-paced environments, excel at managing complex sales cycles, and are energised by building strong customer relationships. At Lattice, sales goes beyond merely pitching a vision or closing deals; it’s about crafting exceptional experiences and building meaningful partnerships with our customers. As an Account Executive, you’ll become a trusted advisor to HR and business leaders by developing deep expertise in the Lattice Talent Suite and broader trends across People Strategy. This role is ideal for someone who brings strong outbound discipline, operates with urgency and ownership, and enjoys navigating multi-stakeholder buying processes. What You Will Do Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through close for Mid-Market organisations, delivering a high-quality customer experience throughout. Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly new business goals. Generate pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting, which represents a critical driver of success in the role. Build and maintain a healthy, disciplined pipeline through strong follow-up, deal management, and forecasting hygiene. Lead thoughtful discovery conversations to uncover business-level challenges and goals. Navigate multiple stakeholders and buying groups throughout the sales process. Position Lattice’s solutions through a consultative sales approach tailored to each customer’s needs. Maintain a strong understanding of the HR technology landscape, industry trends, and Lattice’s competitive positioning to guide customers through the buying process. Partner with Account Managers to identify expansion opportunities within existing customer accounts. Contribute positively to team culture through collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and an eagerness to learn. What You Will Bring to the Table Proven track record in generating new business and surpassing sales and pipeline generation targets. 5+ years of full-cycle SaaS closing experience in a quota-carrying role. Experience managing multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. A high sense of ownership and accountability; you proactively manage your business and don't require close oversight to maintain momentum. An experimental mindset and eagerness to leverage AI and modern sales tools to work smarter, move faster, and improve execution. High coachability, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine desire to continually hone your craft. Passion for Lattice’s mission and alignment with our values: Ship Shipmate Self, Clear Eyes, Own the Outcome, and What’s Next? If you’re a proactive, results-driven sales professional ready to make a significant impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be part of a team that’s redefining the future of sales and customer experience at Lattice. ___ The estimated annual cash salary for this role is £69,500 - £81,750. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, AI
jobs.description: This is Engineering at Lattice Lattice's Engineering team is dedicated to building cutting-edge solutions that empower people and organizations to thrive. As AI becomes fundamental to every product experience, ensuring those systems are trustworthy, measurable, and continuously improving is one of the company's most important engineering challenges. The AI Intelligence Quality (IQ) team owns that challenge. We build the AI Platform that enables every AI team at Lattice to measure quality, detect regressions, run experiments, and continuously improve AI performance with confidence. The platform you lead won't power a single product—it will shape the quality of every AI experience we deliver, becoming a foundational capability for how AI is built at Lattice. What You Will Do Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team of AI and software engineers, developing them into strong technical leaders while fostering a culture of ownership, technical excellence, experimentation, and continuous learning. Own the execution and delivery of the AI Platform roadmap, balancing near-term product impact with long-term platform investments. Partner closely with Product, Applied AI, Data Science, and engineering leaders to define how AI quality is measured, evaluated, and continuously improved across Lattice. Lead the development of AI evaluation infrastructure, quality metrics, experimentation capabilities, observability, and developer tooling that enable every AI product team to confidently build, evaluate, and ship AI experiences. Drive technical and organizational decisions that improve the scalability, reliability, and adoption of the AI Platform, empowering engineers to own architecture and technical solutions. Build strong cross-functional partnerships and influence engineering strategy to establish AI evaluations as a foundational capability that accelerates AI development across Lattice. What You Will Bring to the Table Experience leading and growing high-performing software engineering teams, with a track record of hiring, coaching, and developing engineers into strong technical leaders. Strong technical background leading teams that build AI infrastructure, AI-powered products leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and/or AI agents, distributed systems, or developer platforms. You are a highly technical engineering leader who leads by example—contributing to architecture, design reviews, and code reviews, diving into implementation details when needed, and raising the technical bar across the team. Experience building enterprise SaaS AI products where quality, trust, reliability, and scalability are critical to customer success. Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution, partnering effectively with Product, Applied AI, Data Science, and Engineering to deliver business impact. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to create clarity, align teams, and influence technical direction in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. A strong product and platform mindset, balancing customer impact, engineering velocity, operational excellence, and long-term technical investments. A leadership style grounded in curiosity, humility, ownership, and continuous learning, with a passion for building exceptional engineering teams and delivering high-quality AI products. Nice to Have Experience building AI evaluation frameworks, experimentation platforms, or ML infrastructure. Knowledge of statistical experimentation, A/B model testing, offline evaluations, or model benchmarking. Familiarity with advanced AI optimization techniques such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), model fine-tuning, or preference learning. Experience building internal platforms and services adopted across multiple engineering teams. #LI-remote The estimated annual cash salary for this role is $187,500 - $234,500. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice’s applicable plans. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description: What You Will Do We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the future of the Lattice MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and the integrations that power Lattice AI. This is the connective layer that lets customers use Lattice performance data inside the AI tools they already work in (Claude, ChatGPT, Glean, Microsoft Copilot, and Slack), and that brings third-party productivity data (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Linear, Zoom, Asana) into Lattice. As AI becomes the center of gravity for how companies work, this surface is how Lattice stays connected, interoperable, and indispensable. You’ll join a fully staffed engineering team ready to execute, and together you’ll make ecosystem interoperability a reason customers choose and stay with Lattice.  If you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping platform strategy, and working with great internal and external partners, you’ll love the impact you can have here. As a Lead Product Manager for MCP & AI Ecosystem, you will: Own the MCP and AI ecosystem strategy. Not only decide what features and integrations to pursue, but what MCP and AI mean to Lattice and our customers. Become a thought leader on how AI should shape HR for the better. Ship integrations that create leverage. Deliver new MCP tools, resources, and third-party connectors that expand what admins, managers, and executives can do with Lattice data in the flow of work. Build durable foundations, like authentication, agentic execution frameworks, and evals that make future integrations faster, more scalable, and easier to adopt and maintain. Be a technical thought partner to Engineering. Help shape technical direction on MCP tool design and third party integration infrastructure, translating complex constraints into clear product decisions. Drive go-to-market with partners. Partner with Partnerships, Product Marketing, to launch integrations that deliver measurable customer and ecosystem impact. Own outcomes. Influence and own key results across integration and MCP adoption, reliability, activation, and ecosystem growth. What You Will Bring to the Table We’re looking for a seasoned product manager with the technical depth and strategic instincts to shape Lattice’s next generation of integrations and APIs. You’ll be a great fit if you have a combination of: 7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of integrations, platform, or ecosystem surfaces (built end-to-end, not just configured). Direct experience building technical integrations in a multi-party ecosystem — for example ad technology / marketing technology, marketplaces, developer platforms, payments, data connectivity, or similar — where partnership strategy shaped what you built. Strong technical fluency: comfortable with third-party integration patterns, data sync and field mapping, webhooks, and auth/OAuth; you can hold a credible architecture conversation with engineers and partner CTOs. A track record of shipping scalable, reliable integrations in partnership with engineering, and of standing up partner or marketplace launches with go-to-market teams. Evidence of turning a platform or ecosystem into a competitive advantage — a reason customers chose your product, not just a checkbox. Clear, confident communication that brings internal teams and external partners into alignment. A bias for action and the ability to create structure in an ambiguous, fast-moving space.  Bonus: Exposure to AI ecosystems, MCP, AI agents, or LLM tooling (helpful, not required). Experience in multi-product B2B SaaS, or with HR/people-data or other sensitive-data workflows. If you have strong experience with integrations, APIs, or platform products, even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification, we encourage you to apply. We’re looking for strong product thinkers with deep technical fluency, not perfect resumes. Location Requirement: This role is open to candidates located in British Columbia or Ontario, Canada.
